Here's the corrected and rephrased version:

"As suggested, moving forward, let's include the SQL_ID in our requests to the L2/L4 team when requesting query tuning. This will help avoid back-and-forth clarification and prevent delays in the investigation."

Alternative versions:

**More formal:**
"Following the recommendation, we will ensure that all future query tuning requests to the L2/L4 team include the SQL_ID. This will eliminate unnecessary follow-up questions and expedite the investigation process."

**More concise:**
"Going forward, we'll include the SQL_ID in all query tuning requests to the L2/L4 team to avoid delays caused by clarification requests."
